notes.title: minor map tweaks
notes.content: Hey hey! Just dropping in to let y'all know we've made a few slight tweaks to Bootcamp, and have modified the camera rendering and lighting.

notes.title: We're Back!!
notes.content:
Good afternoon, everybody - and happy Fourth of July weekend!

This announcement comes as an incredible shock to us, and I'm sure it comes as a shock to you as well.

To sum: we've recovered the development files for Project Polygun. Or at least, we've recovered most of them. We've lost nearly all the maps, and are now currently down to just our original Bootcamp map. Technically one or two of the other maps exist in the codebase, but we're planning on keeping those locked away for the time being. However, we feel that this gives us a very solid ground to start from, and build up from there. The Bootcamp map isn't perfect, but we plan on tweaking it over time until it reaches perfection, adding balances and whatnot based on your suggestions.

Also, with this announcement/update, we've made a few modifications to the current weapons roster, including initial beta-polishing of our new Blaster weapon. We've also added in a couple new sound effects to each gun, and due to a very specific request we've replaced the SCAR-L with the AK-74 as the main primary weapon.

On top of this, we've temporarily disabled the Bot Training mode as well as pulled away the Bot AI.

After learning our lesson from the previous loss, we've taken the time to ensure we do proper backups of all game files so this doesn't happen again.

Over the coming moments, we're going to be updating the store page to reflect the fact that Project Polygun is officially back in development.

Also, we feel that this is incredibly important to disclose: while we ARE officially back in development, the development process is going to be a bit.. slow. It's not like we're a massive team of developers working on this game or anything - we've still gotta clock in to our 9-5's and make sure the lights stay on and the bills are all paid. While we'd love nothing more than to work full-time on this project, it is unfortunately taking a back-burner to our daily lives. HOWEVER, this doesn't mean the development isn't going to be active! It's just going to be slow.

We'd like to thank you all for your patience, and thank you for sticking around. We're looking forward to seeing you all on the battlefields.

Much love,

~The Arkadia Galactic team

notes.title: We Need To Talk
notes.content:
Top of the morning to ya, gamers.

We're coming to you with a heavy heart.

This past year has been incredibly rough on us all, and together we've gotten through some very difficult events - many that nobody could've seen coming.

Unfortunately, one such event targets our community specifically, and it's this event that we would like to discuss with you today.

Some time ago, shortly before the scheduled release of Project Polygun, we unfortunately lost access to the original development files. We've seen far too many excellent games go entirely defunct because their development team stopped caring about the project and never updated it. As a team, we're unilaterally uncomfortable with the idea of releasing a project into the wild only for it to never be updated.

It would be one thing if Project Polygun was polished to perfection. But due to the nature of our design philosophy, that just isn't the case. I'm going to be frank with you - the game is bugged, the networking is flawed, the maps aren't fully balanced, and some of the weapons are cheesed beyond all belief.

Here's the thing - we care about this project greatly, and we care about our community even more. Afterall, it's our community (that's you guys) that made this entire thing possible. We wouldn't be here if it weren't for you.

So we were faced with a difficult decision: release the title - knowing it would never receive another update for its entire lifetime, or don't release it - and pretend it never existed. For this past year, we chose the latter.

Or at least, we tried.

We've gotten countless comments about the state of the game, and numerous more requests for its release. After many, many nights of deliberation we've reached our final decision.

We're going to release Project Polygun.

But there's something that you need to bear in mind before making the decision to enjoy our game, and it can't be stressed enough: unless by some miracle we were to rebuild the entire game from the ground up, Project Polygun will never receive another update - content or otherwise. It is going out into the world effectively dead in the water, in the same exact state it was in back on July 1st of 2020, effectively frozen in time. Please, *DO NOT* bother wasting your time on this title without acknowledging that it'll never be updated from the state it's in.

There's a total of two released maps (Bootcamp and PolygunIsland), plus a third map we used as a development testing field. The maps Corporate and Bombtown never made it into the final update, along with the map showcased in the official trailer or the development trailer. These planned updates were going to be launched with the official scheduled release, but were regrettably lost with the development environment.

We sincerely hope this letter finds you all well, and we're dearly sorry for being unable to continue with this project.

With that being said, within this past month we've begun work on a newer (smaller) title, with the codebase for it being actively hosted on GitHub - so even if our local development environment were to burn to the ground, we would still be able to access and continue the development of our upcoming title. Sure do wish we had the foresight to do that with this one.

For those of you that have read this entire novel and are still fine with supporting our work, we're incredibly excited that you're deciding to stick around, and we hope to see you on the battlefields.

Much love,
The Arkadia Galactic Team

notes.title: Road To Release
notes.content:
Good afternoon guys, gals, and non-binary pals!

Today's the first day of July, and so it's time for our monthly Road To Release update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/e7041eb1807272a3e85c283d109a0b13eb5ce6e7.png[/img]

First off, we'd like to finally introduce the first official Project Polygun map! Say hello to: Bootcamp - a small dual-military-outpost featuring fantastic rock formations and a crashed cargo jet in the center for opposing teams to duke it out across.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/6a7ed94051de833b7d020b7e08610f0dcc1d1b7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/8f49b78cecc76442236202cc55665c1c7f118aa6.png[/img]

Secondly, we've added in some nifty new particle effects. Specifically, ones for the smoke grenade and the frag grenade. Now you can blow up your enemies in adorable polygonal style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/5b0f38c8aa1a0f88b39e7bd1658e640594244550.png[/img]

The last semi-major thing is the lighting change. Very bloom! Much sunrays! Many lensflares!

Oh, and we finally got rid of those horrid robot first-person arms. There are still some issues with the way the model is being displayed, but at least the style is consistent with the theme. We might have to hire a new hand model, though.

notes.title: Upcoming Release!
notes.content:
Hey gamers, it's official! We've brought things to a solid point and now we're looking forward to our upcoming release. This is the official launch announcement of Project Polygun!!

[b]We're planning to release on November 2nd, 2020.[/b]

Over the next few months, we're going to focus heavily on final polishing and bug fixes in order to get our game to a solid releasable state (as well as to focus on a ton of marketing in the meantime). Also, after all this time, we've FINALLY gotten source control set up. For the non-nerds: that means we now have a solid working environment for our team to collaborate on the game's code and files with ease, helping to expedite the development process and make things a helluvalot easier to do.

We're looking forward to November, and can't wait to see you all on the battlefields!

Much love,
The Arkadia Galactic Team

notes.title: WIP Wednesday
notes.content:
Today is now the second Wednesday of June, which means it's time for what will no longer be your Weekly WIP Wednesday!

Due to staffing changes in our team as well as various other factors, we're going to scale back our updates to a monthly rate. From this point forward, every update will occur on the 1st of each month, and we'll be building for the future. This allows us to focus on larger releases as well as to spend time curating special events for different holidays, on top of having more time to squash any bugs that may crop up during development.

That being said, we've attached this update's changelog below, as always. Much love!

~CHANGELOG~
~Updated Deagle fire sound
~Updated recoil for secondaries
~Adjusted falloff and range on sniper, players now need to adjust for bullet drop
~Adjusted damage on sniper
~Increased sniper fire rate
~Adjusted primary recoil on weapons to closer match titles such as COD

notes.title: WIP Wednesday
notes.content:
Today is now the first Wednesday of June, so it's time for your weekly WIP Wednesday!

This week's update adds a whole new map and game mode, as well as some minor cleaning of the game files and some quality of life changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/3ad3b19e4d69fad8e64e41c3de2afd2f4753ea22.png[/img]

First off, we hired a crew to fly out to Polygun Island and do some electrical work to get the lighting fixtures repaired. Now instead of trying to fight in pure darkness, there are bright lights illuminating key choke points throughout the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/f712daa8baa4a0841598ab403f27d8d9b5a99a7b.png[/img]

The biggest and most exciting change for this update, however, is the new map and game mode. Introducing: Corporate. This map features a sprawling set of mirrored office buildings with plenty of hallways and cubicles to fight around while assisting your team in the new Capture The Flag game mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/13a027a7fb2f5a5a1c823ab21eb3dcbb9eca91b0.png[/img]

With plenty of rooms and obstacles, there are lots of corners to lob grenades around and to peak over with your trusty shotgun. Located smack dab between the two buildings is a small alleyway that allows teams to skirmish as they push multiple entrances into the opposing building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/ec4d835b3dfd73042e809f5fd6f76c5543f5374a.png[/img]

~CHANGELOG~
~Added working spotlights to Polygun Island
~Changed Polygun Island to Deathmatch game mode
~Added more vehicles to Bombtown
~Changed Bombtown to Team Deathmatch game mode
~Added Corporate map
~Added Capture The Flag game mode on Corporate
~removed SteamVR, OculusVR, and various mobile libraries from game packaging
~removed original game mode test maps from the packaging

notes.title: WIP Wednesday
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday, everyone! It's time for your weekly Work-In-Progress Wednesday update.

This week's update brings a lot of polishing and some quality-of-life changes to the table. As always, the full changelog will be featured down below. For now, let's get started on featuring the biggest and most obvious change for Project Polygun: the lighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/d593299d2bf990e207abff4b9942bd653d7d39d5.png[/img]

While I don't want to say we overhauled the lighting, anything short of that would be stretching the truth - the maps look incredibly different with the new lighting changes. For now, we've only made changes to the lighting in Polygun Island and Bombtown, to an incredibly drastic effect. Featured in the image above is a shot of the absolutely gorgeous sunset effect seen in Bombtown - the entire map is covered in a beautiful orange hue, with a burning sun seen just over the mountaintops in the distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/f4be641e10302aa3dbe4f59fbb6a3f5ad93ecb4a.png[/img]

The lighting on Polygun Island, however, will require you to make use of the sounds your enemies make while moving, plus any flashes of light caused by explosions or gunfire. This results in a much more difficult terrain to navigate, and we hope it'll bring an exciting challenge. In the future, we might see further updates to the map, adding various small light sources at key locations and choke points.

~CHANGELOG~
~Fixed recoil for most weapons
~Updated sounds for all weapons
~Added vehicles to Bombtown
~Updated ammo crate model
~Added ammo crate to Bombtown
~Updated vehicle engine volume and health
~Updated gas pumps to explode, and increased gas pump damage radius
~Nerfed Assault class ability
~Buffed Scout class ability
~Updated medic bot color scheme
~Updated intro logo
~Added music
~Made Polygun Island immensely dark
~Updated lighting on Bombtown
~Added blocking volumes on all maps to prevent players from leaving the play area

notes.title: Work-In-Progress Wednesday
notes.content:
Howdy, folks! Today's Wednesday, so it's time for your weekly update.

The biggest thing we've worked on is updating the different playable classes. Now, not only does each team have its own colorations, but each class has a distinct design.

[h3]Assault Class[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/61e7214f94494637bef449b9006bd91555e01000.png[/img]

[h3]Medic Class[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/348dafad2e3604d1707e6a98268ee96b73fcad66.png[/img]

[h3]Scout Class[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/87b191193db204c140edb21942308cdbd612749d.png[/img]

[h3]Support Class[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35278594/d5ec8aa12157d18f5b70b56a61b9c3a33a5c23ac.png[/img]

We hope these changes will help to bring a tactical advantage to both opposing teams, allowing you to strategize with your squad and easily pinpoint which enemies are the most valuable targets.

The majority of the updates for today have been graphical. Yeah, we know this update isn't very large, but we just got back into the swing of things and this update is literally just a couple hours worth of work (because we're wanting to get this pushed by noon local time) so you've gotta bear with us just a little bit. <3

That being said, you can view this week's changelog below to see what we've accomplished in this update.

~CHANGELOG~
~Fixed clipping on vehicles
~Shotguns have increased spread, resulting in them being less practical for long-distance engagement
~Updated the model for the mine traps
~Updated enemy team textures

notes.title: Massive Overhaul
notes.content:
Hey there, kids! Do you like violence? I know that we sure do!

Life has been incredibly hectic lately and we've had to take development underground. But we're popping back up into the spotlight to announce a couple of major things. First off, we're in the process of changing our title's name. After a lot of consideration and debilitation, we've settled on "Project Polygun" as our flagship's namesake.

The second biggest change is we're putting the Battle Royale mode on the backburner in order to focus on hosting smaller FPS game modes such as Team Deathmatch and Capture The Flag. Once these are fully fleshed out, then we'll hope to take another crack at the Battle Royale mode we've all come to know and love.

That being said, BR will be unavailable for the time-being. In its stead are several new game modes, each featured on a whole new map.

notes.title: Weapons and Inventory
notes.content:
Hello guys, gals, and nonbinary pals!

It's Wednesday, so it's time to update you all on the progress so far.

This week brings some very exciting changes mostly to do with the weaponry, but we've also got a nice non-weapon-related update to cover as well.

First and foremost, we've added in some new weapon models as well as weapon types, giving the game a bit more variety in your murder options. We've also added different ammo boxes that are specific for each weapon depending on what it's chambered in.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/419c5392c066ca9bbd507939b9fcf78f4c373a23.png[/img]

On top of this, we've completely revamped how the inventory works. Previously, you would pick up a weapon and find ammo for it, but that would be the only weapon you could carry. If you wanted a different weapon, it would be dropped and swapped for the new one. Ammunition wasn't all that great either, as it was only one ammo type for all guns even though they were registering as different ammo types. Basically, if you found an UZI then grabbed an ammo crate, that ammo would be registered as UZI ammo. If you then swapped to an AK47, you couldn't use any of the ammo you found but would instead have to find a new instance of ammo. All in all, it was just a terrible way of doing things.

So we fixed it.

Also, check out that beautiful new inventory layout!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/524e835160cfd076212090d427d7eb3df676c713.png[/img]

Aiming now works differently as well, in the sense that you can now aim down sights in order to get better aim and land shots more frequently.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/bff8adaca00b05478478ddc827ced5f8f53577b4.png[/img]

Speaking of weapons, that's all been redone as well. In the beginning, everything was raycast and had the same range. This was an awful way to do things, and it meant shotguns were incredibly overpowered. Imagine being able to 1-hit snipe somebody from a kilometer away with birdshot - not fun.

So we fixed it.

Now every weapon has its own recoil patterns, and we utilize a ballistics model so you'll have to lead your shots and be mindful of bullet drop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/aa8fc7b2873a7f76328bf094b8045c420fbcddf4.png[/img]

And now for some glamour shots!

Mmm, look at those buildings!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/16f18a543ccefec6eac36488440871e37897ef22.png[/img]

That's a very nice combat-training range!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/fbfa334ee626f726b924fb3a17ae8128745e8105.png[/img]

This game is such literal trash, we've got a junkyard!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/25b38280547b375864b26738f4c281e94b1afc72.png[/img]

That about covers it for this update, and we'll see you all next Wednesday.

notes.title: Buildings and Models
notes.content:
Hey guys, gals, and nonbinary pals!

Today's update brings primarily graphical overhauls that help to flesh out the game world and make it more of a living world.

One of the things we've done is added some more props to the southeastern town, and adding catwalks between some of the buildings.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/dd797cc99761a0c10ba70adcb411aeb51352f7fa.png[/img]

Moving forward with the same mindset, we've overhauled the old military base. Now it's much bigger, much meaner, and much greener.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/51acd0cb1b811e81e5a92222865555c27d9c4297.png[/img]

Speaking of greener overhauls, we've completely changed the airplane! Now it flies in the direction it's pointing instead of floating sideways, and it's also a non-destroyed plane. Why? Because it just doesn't make sense for a plane to be destroyed and flying.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/ca59feab2e9b2d8d0e7257fc5af67a384c6a4eb9.png[/img]

Our biggest and most exciting bit of this update, however, comes in the form of building interiors. We've been working hard to recreate the buildings in the central town, and now a handful of them have been fully rebuilt with furnished interiors.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/0aad39bcfd6e77bb4b8d987215a39ec6e4b2c20f.png[/img]

Honestly, we've gotta say it looks very good. Now there's more room to hide, more chances to find loot, more corners for danger to lurk around.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35278594/6625911915bd6abe68af518267bda9f15fc9343b.png[/img]

Now on to the coding side of things.

Previously, we were having some issues with the particle effects spawning from the middle of the weapons whenever a gun is fired. Not only did this not look good, but this also did not look good. Did we mention it did not look good?

Needless to say, it's been updated. So now the muzzle flash particle effect will spawn at the exit of the barrel of each gun, just like the real thing!

notes.title: Weapons and Graphics
notes.content:
Good morning guys, gals, and nonbinary pals!

Today, we're bringing you a minor - yet important - update to EACG, one that's going to lay the groundwork for things to come.

The first major thing we've changed is the character model. We've implemented new animations as well as changed the mesh for the model entirely, ditching behind the default model of the Unreal Engine. Thanks a bunch, Synty!

Secondly, we've added a few tweaks to the weapons that are sure to please: each gun now has their own range and sound effect, and we've also added a new and powerful Sniper Rifle - boasting extreme range and powerful shots, this weapon is incredibly deadly in the right hands.
